example1_en: I left a note beside your breakfast bowl.
example1_zh: 我在你的早餐碗旁留了一張便條。
example2_en: Students who take notes in their own words may develop a deeper understanding of complex material.
example2_zh: 用自己的話記筆記的學生可能會對複雜的學習材料形成更深入的理解。
collocations: take notes｜記筆記 ; leave a note｜留便條 ; note that｜注意到…… ; musical note｜音符
tip_zh: 記筆記用take notes；note that後接完整句子。

meanings_zh: v. 落下；跌倒；下降 | n. 跌落；下降 | n. 秋天（美式）
definition_en: To move downward, lose balance, or decrease. | An act of falling or a decrease in amount. | The season between summer and winter, especially in American English.
example1_en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
example1_zh: 金黃的葉子落在我們屋外的小路上。
example2_en: Energy consumption may fall if governments encourage households to install better insulation and efficient heating systems.
example2_zh: 如果政府鼓勵家庭改善隔熱條件並安裝高效供暖系統，能源消耗可能會下降。
collocations: fall asleep｜入睡 ; fall in prices｜價格下降 ; fall sharply｜急劇下降 ; in the fall｜在秋天
tip_zh: 過去式fell，過去分詞fallen；秋天英式常用autumn。

meanings_zh: num. 三十
definition_en: The number equal to three groups of ten.
example1_en: The soup needs another thirty minutes on the stove.
example1_zh: 這鍋湯還需要在爐子上再煮三十分鐘。
example2_en: The survey found that thirty per cent of residents preferred cycling to driving for short journeys.
example2_zh: 調查發現，百分之三十的居民在短途出行時更願意騎車而不是開車。
collocations: thirty minutes｜三十分鐘 ; thirty per cent｜百分之三十 ; in your thirties｜在三十多歲時
tip_zh: thirty重音在前；thirteen重音通常在後。

meanings_zh: adj. 最好的；最佳的 | adv. 最好地；最 | n. 最佳表現；最好事物
definition_en: Better than all others in quality or suitability. | In the most successful way or to the greatest degree. | The finest performance, effort, or thing available.
example1_en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
example1_zh: 這家麵包店做的麵包是我們街區最好的。
example2_en: Investing in early education may be the best way to reduce inequality over time.
example2_zh: 投資早期教育可能是逐步減少不平等的最佳方式。
collocations: the best option｜最佳選擇 ; do your best｜盡最大努力 ; at its best｜處於最佳狀態 ; like something best｜最喜歡某物
tip_zh: best是good和well的最高階；形容詞前通常加the。

meanings_zh: det. 一些；任何一個 | pron. 一些；任何一個 | adv. 絲毫；一點
definition_en: Some in questions or negatives; whichever one, without restriction. | Some or whichever ones, without naming the people or things. | At all, used mainly with comparisons in questions or negatives.
example1_en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
example1_zh: 這個書架上的書，你想借哪本都可以。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that all children can attend school without facing any financial barriers.
example2_zh: 政府應確保所有兒童都能上學，不受任何經濟障礙的阻礙。
collocations: any questions｜任何問題 ; at any time｜隨時 ; any of these｜這些中的任何一個 ; hardly any｜幾乎沒有
tip_zh: 疑問、否定句中常表“一些”；肯定句中常表“任何”。

meanings_zh: n. 計算機；電腦
definition_en: An electronic machine that stores and processes information using programs.
example1_en: My computer froze while I was editing holiday photos.
example1_zh: 我編輯度假照片時，電腦卡住了。
example2_en: Access to a computer at home can help students complete assignments and develop essential digital skills.
example2_zh: 在家能使用電腦可以幫助學生完成作業，並培養必要的數位技能。
collocations: computer software｜計算機軟體 ; computer skills｜計算機操作技能 ; computer network｜計算機網路 ; computer science｜電腦科學
tip_zh: 在電腦上工作用work on a computer。

meanings_zh: n. 購物 | n. 買來的物品（英）
definition_en: The activity of looking for and buying things. | The things you have bought during a shopping trip.
example1_en: We usually do our shopping early on Saturday mornings.
example1_zh: 我們通常在星期六一早去購物。
example2_en: The growth of online shopping has changed consumer habits and increased demand for home delivery services.
example2_zh: 網上購物的發展改變了消費者習慣，也增加了對送貨上門服務的需求。
collocations: go shopping｜去購物 ; do the shopping｜採購日用品 ; online shopping｜網上購物 ; shopping centre｜購物中心
tip_zh: shopping作名詞不可數；“去購物”用go shopping。

meanings_zh: n. 字母表
definition_en: the complete set of letters used in a language
example1_en: My little sister learned the alphabet through a song.
example1_zh: 我的小妹妹通過一首歌學會了字母表。
example2_en: Learning the alphabet is an important early step towards literacy, but children also need regular reading practice.
example2_zh: 學習字母表是掌握讀寫能力的重要起點，但孩子也需要經常練習閱讀。
collocations: the English alphabet｜英語字母表 ; learn the alphabet｜學習字母表 ; alphabet song｜字母歌
tip_zh: alphabet指整套字母；單個字母用letter。

meanings_zh: n. 地址；網址 | v. 處理；設法解決 | v. 向…講話；致辭
definition_en: Details identifying where someone lives or something can be found. | To give attention to a problem and try to solve it. | To speak directly to a person or group.
example1_en: Please send me your address before I post the parcel.
example1_zh: 請在我寄包裹之前把你的地址發給我。
example2_en: Governments need to address housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
example2_zh: 政府需要通過支援可負擔住房建設和改善公共交通連線來應對住房短缺。
collocations: postal address｜郵寄地址 ; email address｜電子郵箱地址 ; address a problem｜處理問題 ; address an audience｜向聽眾講話
tip_zh: 美音動詞讀/əˈdres/；address問題不等於已解決。

meanings_zh: v. 獲勝；贏得 | v. 爭取到；獲得 | n. 勝利
definition_en: To succeed in a competition or receive a prize. | To gain something through effort or personal qualities. | A successful result in a competition or contest.
example1_en: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
example1_zh: 儘管下著大雨，我們隊還是贏得了比賽。
example2_en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
example2_zh: 為了贏得公眾支援，政府必須解釋環境政策將如何讓社群長期受益。
collocations: win a prize｜獲獎 ; win a match｜贏得比賽 ; win support｜贏得支援 ; win someone's trust｜贏得某人的信任
tip_zh: 過去式和過去分詞均為won；贏比賽用win，擊敗人用beat。

meanings_zh: v. 生長；增長；發展 | v. 種植 | v. 逐漸變得
definition_en: To become bigger or develop over time. | To raise plants for food or other purposes. | To gradually become different in condition or feeling.
example1_en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
example1_zh: 我們在廚房窗邊的花盆裡種新鮮香草。
example2_en: As cities grow, local authorities must invest in transport systems that serve expanding populations.
example2_zh: 隨著城市發展，地方政府必須投資建設滿足不斷增長的人口需求的交通系統。
collocations: grow rapidly｜迅速增長 ; grow vegetables｜種蔬菜 ; grow older｜年齡漸長 ; grow increasingly concerned｜變得越來越擔憂
tip_zh: 過去式grew，過去分詞grown；表變得後接形容詞。

meanings_zh: n. 盒子；箱子 | v. 把…裝箱 | v. 打拳擊
definition_en: a container with firm sides, often with a lid | to put something into a box | to compete in a sport using punches and protective gloves
example1_en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
example1_zh: 小貓在一個空紙箱裡睡著了。
example2_en: Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.
example2_zh: 零售商可以選擇與每件商品大小相近的箱子，以減少包裝浪費。
collocations: cardboard box｜紙箱 ; a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力 ; box up｜裝箱
tip_zh: 複數為boxes；a box of後接盒中物品。

meanings_zh: n. 樂趣；快樂 | adj. 有趣的；令人愉快的
definition_en: Enjoyment or pleasure from an activity or experience. | Enjoyable and entertaining.
example1_en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我們一起堆沙堡，玩得特別開心。
example2_en: Making physical activity fun can encourage children to exercise regularly and develop healthier habits throughout their lives.
example2_zh: 讓體育活動充滿樂趣，可以鼓勵兒童經常鍛鍊，並養成終身受益的健康習慣。
collocations: have fun｜玩得開心 ; for fun｜為了好玩 ; make fun of｜取笑 ; good fun｜很有趣
tip_zh: fun作名詞不可數；funny多指好笑的或奇怪的。

meanings_zh: n. 鬍鬚；絡腮鬍子
definition_en: Hair growing on a person's chin and cheeks.
example1_en: He trimmed his beard before leaving for work.
example1_zh: 他上班出門前修剪了鬍鬚。
example2_en: In some workplaces, employees with beards must use special coverings to maintain food hygiene standards.
example2_zh: 在一些工作場所，蓄鬍須的員工必須佩戴專用罩具，以符合食品衛生標準。
collocations: grow a beard｜蓄鬍須 ; trim a beard｜修剪鬍鬚 ; a thick beard｜濃密的鬍鬚
tip_zh: beard指下巴及兩頰鬍鬚；moustache指上唇鬍鬚。

meanings_zh: adj. 溼的；潮溼的 | adj. 多雨的；下雨的 | v. 弄溼
definition_en: Covered with or containing water or another liquid | Having rain or frequent rainfall | To put water or another liquid onto something
example1_en: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
example1_zh: 我踩進水坑，把襪子弄溼了。
example2_en: Prolonged wet weather can damage crops and make it harder for farmers to harvest them efficiently.
example2_zh: 持續的陰雨天氣會損害莊稼，使農民更難高效收穫。
collocations: get wet｜變溼 ; wet weather｜陰雨天氣 ; soaking wet｜溼透的 ; wet the cloth｜把布弄溼
tip_zh: damp指微溼；soaking wet表示溼透。

meanings_zh: n. 錢；貨幣 | n. 財富；財產
definition_en: What people use to pay for goods and services. | The wealth that a person or organisation owns.
example1_en: I saved enough money to buy a new bicycle.
example1_zh: 我攢夠了買一輛新腳踏車的錢。
example2_en: Governments should invest more money in public transport to reduce congestion and improve air quality.
example2_zh: 政府應該向公共交通投入更多資金，以緩解擁堵並改善空氣質量。
collocations: save money｜省錢；存錢 ; spend money on｜花錢買 ; value for money｜物有所值 ; raise money｜籌款
tip_zh: 通常不可數：說much money，不說many money。

meanings_zh: v. 同意；贊成 | v. 商定；答應
definition_en: Have the same opinion or accept someone else's view | Decide something together or promise to do something
example1_en: I agree with you that this soup needs salt.
example1_zh: 我同意你的看法，這湯需要加鹽。
example2_en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
example2_zh: 大多數研究人員認為，經常運動可以改善心理健康和學業表現。
collocations: agree with someone｜同意某人的觀點 ; agree on a plan｜就計劃達成一致 ; agree to do something｜答應做某事 ; agree to a proposal｜同意一項提議
tip_zh: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答應做用to do。

meanings_zh: adv. 現在；如今 | adv. 馬上；立刻 | conj. 既然；由於
definition_en: at the present time | immediately, without waiting | because a situation has changed or become true
example1_en: We live near the station now, so walking is easy.
example1_zh: 我們現在住在車站附近，步行過去很方便。
example2_en: Now that online courses are widely available, more adults can continue their education while working.
example2_zh: 既然線上課程已廣泛普及，更多成年人就能在工作的同時繼續接受教育。
collocations: right now｜現在；馬上 ; by now｜到現在為止 ; from now on｜從現在起 ; now that｜既然
tip_zh: now that引導原因從句，強調情況已發生變化。

meanings_zh: adj. 真實的；實際存在的 | adj. 真的；非仿製的 | adj. 實際的；扣除通脹的
definition_en: existing in fact rather than being imagined | genuine rather than copied or artificial | measured after allowing for changes in prices
example1_en: I thought the bird was plastic, but it was real.
example1_zh: 我以為那隻鳥是塑膠的，沒想到是真的。
example2_en: Although average salaries have increased, rising prices mean that many workers have experienced a fall in real income.
example2_zh: 雖然平均工資上漲了，但物價上漲意味著許多勞動者的實際收入有所下降。
collocations: real life｜現實生活 ; real leather｜真皮 ; real income｜實際收入 ; real danger｜真正的危險
tip_zh: real修飾名詞；表示“很、真正地”通常用really。

meanings_zh: pron. 某人；有人
definition_en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated
example1_en: Someone left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
example1_zh: 有人把一把藍色雨傘落在了前門旁邊。
example2_en: Students may feel more confident seeking help when someone they trust is available to discuss their concerns.
example2_zh: 如果有信任的人可以傾聽他們的困擾，學生求助時可能會更有信心。
collocations: someone else｜別人 ; someone special｜特別的人 ; someone to talk to｜可以傾訴的人
tip_zh: 作主語時謂語用單數；後文可用they指代。

meanings_zh: v. 聽見；聽到 | v. 聽說；得知 | v. 審理；聽取
definition_en: notice a sound through your ears | receive information about something | listen formally to evidence or arguments
example1_en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
example1_zh: 我能聽見臥室窗外的鳥鳴聲。
example2_en: Local councils should hear residents' concerns before making decisions about major changes to public transport.
example2_zh: 地方議會在對公共交通作出重大調整前，應聽取居民的顧慮。
collocations: hear from someone｜收到某人的訊息 ; hear about something｜聽說某事 ; hear a case｜審理案件 ; hear both sides｜聽取雙方意見
tip_zh: hear強調聽見；listen to強調主動聽。過去式heard。

meanings_zh: adv. 請；勞駕 | v. 使高興；使滿意
definition_en: Used to make a request or offer more polite. | To make someone feel happy or satisfied.
example1_en: Could you please hold the door for me?
example1_zh: 你能幫我扶一下門嗎？
example2_en: Public policies designed to please every group may fail to address the most urgent social problems.
example2_zh: 旨在取悅所有群體的公共政策，可能無法解決最緊迫的社會問題。
collocations: please do｜請吧；請務必 ; please everyone｜讓所有人滿意 ; hard to please｜難以取悅 ; as you please｜隨你的意願
tip_zh: please是動詞；感到滿意用be pleased。

meanings_zh: adj. 堅硬的 | adj. 困難的；艱苦的 | adv. 努力地；猛烈地
definition_en: Firm and not easily bent, cut, or pressed | Requiring considerable effort or being difficult to endure | With great effort, force, or intensity
example1_en: This bread is too hard to bite into.
example1_zh: 這塊麵包太硬了，咬不動。
example2_en: Many students work hard to gain qualifications, yet still find it difficult to secure stable employment.
example2_zh: 許多學生努力取得學歷或資格，卻仍然難以找到穩定的工作。
collocations: hard work｜艱苦的工作 ; work hard｜努力工作 ; hard evidence｜確鑿的證據 ; hard surface｜堅硬的表面
tip_zh: hard可作副詞“努力地”；hardly意為“幾乎不”。

meanings_zh: adj. 糟糕的；令人不快的 | adj. 可怕的；嚴重的
definition_en: Very bad or unpleasant. | Causing great fear, suffering, or harm.
example1_en: The soup tasted terrible, so I made a sandwich.
example1_zh: 湯很難喝，於是我做了個三明治。
example2_en: Poor waste management can have terrible consequences for public health, especially in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 垃圾管理不善可能給公共健康帶來嚴重後果，在人口密集的城市尤其如此。
collocations: terrible weather｜糟糕的天氣 ; a terrible mistake｜嚴重的錯誤 ; feel terrible｜感覺很難受
tip_zh: terrible是形容詞；表示“非常”通常用terribly。

meanings_zh: v. 感到；覺得 | v. 觸控；摸索 | n. 觸感；氛圍
definition_en: Experience an emotion, physical sensation, or personal belief. | Touch something to discover its texture, shape, or position. | The quality something has when touched or experienced.
example1_en: I feel much warmer with this soft blanket.
example1_zh: 蓋著這條柔軟的毯子，我覺得暖和多了。
example2_en: Residents often feel safer when public spaces are well lit and regularly maintained by local authorities.
example2_zh: 當公共空間照明充足且由地方政府定期維護時，居民往往更有安全感。
collocations: feel comfortable｜感到舒適 ; feel strongly about｜對……有強烈看法 ; feel like doing something｜想做某事 ; get a feel for｜逐漸瞭解
tip_zh: 過去式和過去分詞均為felt；feel後可直接接形容詞。

meanings_zh: n. 玩具 | v. 擺弄；漫不經心地考慮
definition_en: An object that children use for play. | To handle casually or consider without serious commitment.
example1_en: The baby dropped her toy behind the sofa.
example1_zh: 寶寶把她的玩具掉到了沙發後面。
example2_en: Well-designed toys can encourage young children to develop practical skills through creative play and exploration.
example2_zh: 設計精良的玩具可以鼓勵幼兒通過創意遊戲和探索來培養實踐技能。
collocations: soft toy｜毛絨玩具 ; toy car｜玩具汽車 ; toy with an idea｜隨意考慮一個想法
tip_zh: 動詞常用toy with；toy with an idea指並不認真地考慮。

meanings_zh: adv. 這麼；如此；非常 | conj. 所以；因此 | adv. 這樣；如此
definition_en: to such a degree or extent | used to introduce a result or consequence | used instead of repeating an idea already mentioned
example1_en: The soup was so hot that I had to wait.
example1_zh: 湯太燙了，我只好等一會兒。
example2_en: Public transport is limited in rural areas, so many residents rely on private cars for essential journeys.
example2_zh: 農村地區的公共交通有限，因此許多居民依靠私家車進行必要的出行。
collocations: so much｜這麼多 ; so far｜到目前為止 ; so that｜以便；因此 ; think so｜認為如此
tip_zh: so修飾形容詞或副詞；such通常修飾名詞短語。

meanings_zh: v. 攀登；爬 | v. 上升；增加 | n. 攀登；上升
definition_en: to move upwards using your feet and often your hands | to increase in amount or level | an act of moving upwards or an increase in level
example1_en: We climbed the hill before stopping for a picnic.
example1_zh: 我們爬上山坡，然後停下來野餐。
example2_en: As housing costs continue to climb, many young adults struggle to live independently in major cities.
example2_zh: 隨著住房成本持續上漲，許多年輕人難以在大城市獨立生活。
collocations: climb a mountain｜登山 ; climb stairs｜爬樓梯 ; a steep climb｜陡峭的攀登路段 ; climb steadily｜穩步上升
tip_zh: 詞尾b不發音；climb a mountain不加介詞。

meanings_zh: n. 鳥
definition_en: an animal with feathers, wings, and a beak that lays eggs
example1_en: A small bird built a nest above our window.
example1_zh: 一隻小鳥在我們窗戶上方築了巢。
example2_en: Protecting native bird species requires preserving their habitats and reducing pollution in both rural and urban areas.
example2_zh: 保護本土鳥類需要維護其棲息地，並減少鄉村和城市地區的汙染。
collocations: a flock of birds｜一群鳥 ; a migratory bird｜候鳥 ; bird watching｜觀鳥 ; a bird of prey｜猛禽
tip_zh: 鳥群用a flock of birds；bird本身是可數名詞。

meanings_zh: n. 遊戲；比賽 | n. 獵物；野味 | adj. 願意嘗試的；有膽量的
definition_en: an activity or contest played according to rules | wild animals hunted for food or sport, or their meat | willing to try something difficult or unfamiliar
example1_en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天晚飯後我們玩了一個桌遊。
example2_en: Cooperative games can help children develop communication skills and learn to solve problems together.
example2_zh: 合作型遊戲能幫助兒童培養溝通能力，並學會共同解決問題。
collocations: board game｜桌遊 ; team game｜團隊運動 ; video game｜電子遊戲 ; be game for｜願意嘗試
tip_zh: 獵物義不可數；be game for表示願意嘗試。

meanings_zh: adj. 單個的；僅一個的 | adj. 單身的；未婚的 | adj. 單程的
definition_en: Only one, rather than several or many. | Not married or not in a romantic relationship. | For travel to a destination without a return journey.
example1_en: A single candle lit the room during the power cut.
example1_zh: 停電時，房間裡只有一支蠟燭照明。
example2_en: No single policy can solve urban congestion without improvements to public transport and local planning.
example2_zh: 如果不改善公共交通和地方規劃，任何單一政策都無法解決城市擁堵。
collocations: a single person｜一個人；單身人士 ; every single day｜每一天 ; a single ticket｜單程票 ; a single parent｜單親家長
tip_zh: 單程票英式常說single ticket，美式用one-way ticket。

meanings_zh: n. 公園 | v. 停車；泊車 | n. 專用園區
definition_en: An open area with grass and trees for public enjoyment. | To stop a vehicle somewhere and leave it there. | An area set aside for a particular activity or purpose.
example1_en: We shared a picnic under the trees in the park.
example1_zh: 我們在公園的樹下共進了野餐。
example2_en: Providing a park within walking distance of every neighbourhood can encourage exercise and strengthen community ties.
example2_zh: 讓每個社群步行可達公園，有助於鼓勵鍛鍊並加強社群聯絡。
collocations: public park｜公共公園 ; park a car｜停車 ; business park｜商務園區 ; national park｜國家公園
tip_zh: 公園用park；英式英語中停車場用car park。

meanings_zh: n. 男孩
definition_en: a male child or young male person
example1_en: The boy carefully carried his puppy across the puddle.
example1_zh: 那個男孩小心地抱著小狗跨過水坑。
example2_en: Every boy and girl should have equal access to education, regardless of their family's income.
example2_zh: 無論家庭收入如何，每個男孩和女孩都應享有平等的受教育機會。
collocations: a little boy｜小男孩 ; a teenage boy｜十幾歲的男孩 ; a baby boy｜男嬰
tip_zh: 通常指未成年男性；稱成年男性為boy可能不禮貌。

meanings_zh: n. 雞 | n. 雞肉
definition_en: A bird kept for its eggs or meat. | Meat from a chicken, eaten as food.
example1_en: The chickens scratched the soil beside our vegetable patch.
example1_zh: 那些雞在我們的菜地旁刨土。
example2_en: Replacing some red meat with chicken can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.
example2_zh: 用雞肉替代部分紅肉，可以減少個人飲食對環境的影響。
collocations: keep chickens｜養雞 ; roast chicken｜烤雞 ; chicken breast｜雞胸肉 ; chicken soup｜雞湯
tip_zh: 指活雞時可數，指雞肉時不可數；小雞常用chick。

meanings_zh: n. 奶；牛奶 | v. 擠奶
definition_en: A white liquid female mammals produce to feed their young. | Take milk from an animal, especially a cow.
example1_en: I poured some cold milk over my cereal.
example1_zh: 我往麥片上倒了些冷牛奶。
example2_en: Milk provides calcium and protein, although people with certain dietary needs may choose suitable alternatives.
example2_zh: 牛奶提供鈣和蛋白質，但有特殊飲食需求的人可以選擇合適的替代品。
collocations: a glass of milk｜一杯牛奶 ; skimmed milk｜脫脂牛奶 ; milk a cow｜給奶牛擠奶
tip_zh: milk通常不可數；說a glass of milk，不說a milk。

meanings_zh: conj. 和；並且 | conj. 然後；就
definition_en: Connects words or statements that belong together. | Connects an action with what follows or results from it.
example1_en: I bought fresh bread and cheese for our picnic.
example1_zh: 我為我們的野餐買了新鮮麵包和乳酪。
example2_en: Governments should invest in public transport and encourage cycling to reduce congestion in growing cities.
example2_zh: 政府應投資公共交通並鼓勵騎行，以緩解發展中城市的交通擁堵。
collocations: both ... and ...｜……和……都 ; and so on｜等等 ; more and more｜越來越多 ; again and again｜一次又一次
tip_zh: 連線並列成分時注意結構一致；口語常弱讀/ən/。

meanings_zh: det. 大多數的；最多的 | pron. 大多數；最大部分 | adv. 最；非常
definition_en: the majority of something, or the greatest amount or number | the majority or greatest part of a group or amount | to the greatest degree; sometimes used to mean very
example1_en: Most shops here close before we finish work.
example1_zh: 這裡大多數商店在我們下班前就關門了。
example2_en: Most urban residents would benefit from reliable public transport that connects residential areas with major employment centres.
example2_zh: 大多數城市居民都會受益於連線住宅區與主要就業中心的可靠公共交通。
collocations: most people｜大多數人 ; most of the time｜大部分時間 ; at most｜至多 ; the most important｜最重要的
tip_zh: 泛指用most people；特指用most of the people。

meanings_zh: n. 故事；經歷的敘述 | n. 新聞報道 | n. 樓層（美式）
definition_en: an account of real or imagined events | a report about an event in the news | one level of a building, in American English
example1_en: Grandma told us a funny story about her childhood.
example1_zh: 奶奶給我們講了一個她童年的趣事。
example2_en: Sharing a personal story can help students understand historical events from a more human perspective.
example2_zh: 分享個人經歷可以幫助學生從更有人情味的角度理解歷史事件。
collocations: tell a story｜講故事 ; short story｜短篇小說 ; news story｜新聞報道 ; true story｜真實故事
tip_zh: 樓層英式寫storey，美式寫story；高度不固定。

meanings_zh: det. 其他的；另外的 | pron. 另外的人或事物
definition_en: Different from or additional to those already mentioned. | A remaining or different person or thing.
example1_en: This shoe fits, but where is the other one?
example1_zh: 這隻鞋合腳，但另一隻在哪裡？
example2_en: Schools should teach practical skills alongside other subjects to prepare students for the demands of adult life.
example2_zh: 學校應在教授其他科目的同時傳授實用技能，讓學生為成年生活的要求做好準備。
collocations: other people｜其他人 ; the other day｜前幾天 ; each other｜彼此 ; on the other hand｜另一方面
tip_zh: other後接名詞；others獨立使用；兩者中另一個用the other。

meanings_zh: n. 蘋果
definition_en: a round fruit with firm flesh and red or green skin
example1_en: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
example1_zh: 我裝了一個蘋果和一個三明治當午餐。
example2_en: Providing fresh fruit, such as apples, in schools may encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
example2_zh: 在學校提供蘋果等新鮮水果，可能有助於鼓勵兒童養成更健康的飲食習慣。
collocations: apple juice｜蘋果汁 ; apple pie｜蘋果派 ; an apple core｜蘋果核 ; a crisp apple｜脆蘋果
tip_zh: 可數名詞；“一個蘋果”用an apple。

meanings_zh: adj. 中國的；漢語的 | n. 漢語；中文 | n. 中國人
definition_en: Relating to China, its people, or its languages. | The group of languages spoken in China, especially Mandarin. | People who come from China.
example1_en: We shared Chinese dumplings at a small restaurant yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我們在一家小餐館一起吃了中式餃子。
example2_en: Learning Chinese can help international students develop a deeper understanding of cultural traditions in China.
example2_zh: 學習漢語可以幫助國際學生更深入地瞭解中國的文化傳統。
collocations: Chinese culture｜中國文化 ; learn Chinese｜學習漢語 ; Chinese characters｜漢字 ; Chinese cuisine｜中國菜
tip_zh: 首字母始終大寫；指一箇中國人常用a Chinese person。

meanings_zh: n. 空氣 | n. 神態；氣氛 | v. 使通風；公開表達
definition_en: The mixture of gases surrounding Earth that people breathe. | A particular quality that someone or something seems to have. | To let fresh air in, or express views publicly.
example1_en: I opened the window to let fresh air in.
example1_zh: 我開啟窗戶，讓新鮮空氣進來。
example2_en: Improving air quality in cities requires cleaner transport and stricter controls on industrial emissions.
example2_zh: 改善城市空氣質量需要更清潔的交通方式，以及對工業排放更嚴格的管控。
collocations: fresh air｜新鮮空氣 ; air pollution｜空氣汙染 ; an air of confidence｜自信的神態 ; air concerns｜公開表達擔憂
tip_zh: 表示空氣時不可數；an air of表示“帶有某種氣質”。

meanings_zh: conj. 因為；由於
definition_en: Introduces the reason why something happens or is true.
example1_en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
example1_zh: 我關上了窗戶，因為房間裡有點冷。
example2_en: Many commuters choose public transport because it is cheaper and produces fewer emissions than driving alone.
example2_zh: 許多通勤者選擇公共交通，因為它比獨自開車更省錢，排放也更少。
collocations: because of the weather｜由於天氣原因 ; because of this｜因此 ; partly because｜部分原因是
tip_zh: because 後接從句；because of 後接名詞或動名詞。

meanings_zh: n. 隊；團隊 | v. 合作；組成團隊
definition_en: a group working together or playing a sport together | to join someone to work together, usually with up
example1_en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
example1_zh: 我們隊贏得比賽後，吃披薩慶祝了一番。
example2_en: Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
example2_zh: 團隊合作有助於學生培養未來就業所必需的溝通能力。
collocations: team member｜團隊成員 ; team spirit｜團隊精神 ; team up with｜與……合作 ; research team｜研究團隊
tip_zh: 英式英語中team可接單數或複數謂語。

meanings_zh: adj. 正確的；合適的 | n. 權利 | adj. 右邊的；右側的
definition_en: Correct, true, or suitable for a particular purpose. | Something you are legally or morally entitled to. | On the side opposite to the left.
example1_en: You picked the right key to open the door.
example1_zh: 你選對了開門的鑰匙。
example2_en: Every child has the right to receive an education, regardless of their family's financial circumstances.
example2_zh: 每個孩子都有受教育的權利，無論其家庭經濟狀況如何。
collocations: the right answer｜正確答案 ; the right to education｜受教育權 ; on the right｜在右邊 ; make the right decision｜作出正確決定
tip_zh: 表示權利用a right to；表示在右邊用on the right。

meanings_zh: adj. 困難的；費力的 | adj. 難相處的；難應付的
definition_en: Needing considerable effort or skill to do or understand. | Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.
example1_en: This heavy suitcase is difficult to carry upstairs.
example1_zh: 這個沉重的行李箱很難搬上樓。
example2_en: Many graduates find it difficult to secure stable employment without previous experience in their chosen field.
example2_zh: 許多畢業生髮現，如果沒有所選領域的工作經驗，就很難找到穩定的工作。
collocations: a difficult decision｜艱難的決定 ; difficult to understand｜難以理解 ; a difficult customer｜難應付的顧客
tip_zh: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty當形容詞。

meanings_zh: n. 鉛筆 | v. 用鉛筆寫或畫
definition_en: A tool with a solid core for writing or drawing. | To write or draw something with a pencil.
example1_en: She sharpened her pencil before sketching the sleeping cat.
example1_zh: 她削好鉛筆，開始畫那隻熟睡的貓。
example2_en: Using a pencil allows students to revise diagrams easily as their understanding of scientific concepts develops.
example2_zh: 使用鉛筆讓學生能隨著對科學概念理解的加深，輕鬆修改圖示。
collocations: sharpen a pencil｜削鉛筆 ; in pencil｜用鉛筆 ; coloured pencil｜彩色鉛筆 ; pencil case｜鉛筆盒
tip_zh: 用鉛筆寫說in pencil；pencil in指暫定安排。

meanings_zh: pron. 某人；有人
definition_en: a person whose identity is unknown or not stated
example1_en: Somebody left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
example1_zh: 有人把一把藍色雨傘落在了前門旁邊。
example2_en: Students are more likely to seek help when they know somebody will listen without judging them.
example2_zh: 如果學生知道有人會傾聽而不評判他們，就更有可能尋求幫助。
collocations: somebody else｜別人 ; somebody to talk to｜可以傾訴的人 ; somebody special｜特別的人
tip_zh: 作主語時謂語用單數；回指常用they。

meanings_zh: n. 人；個人 | n. 語法人稱
definition_en: an individual human being | a grammatical category distinguishing speakers, listeners, and others
example1_en: Only one person was waiting outside the bakery.
example1_zh: 只有一個人在麵包店外等候。
example2_en: Every person should have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of income or employment status.
example2_zh: 每個人都應享有負擔得起的醫療服務，無論其收入或就業狀況如何。
collocations: in person｜親自；當面 ; a young person｜一個年輕人 ; the average person｜普通人 ; first person｜第一人稱
tip_zh: 普通複數用people；persons多見於正式法律語境。

meanings_zh: n. 街道
definition_en: a public road in a town, usually lined with buildings
example1_en: We crossed the street to reach the bakery.
example1_zh: 我們穿過街道來到麵包店。
example2_en: Planting trees along busy streets can improve air quality and make urban neighbourhoods more pleasant for pedestrians.
example2_zh: 沿繁忙街道植樹可以改善空氣質量，讓城市街區更適宜步行。
collocations: cross the street｜過馬路 ; busy street｜繁忙的街道 ; residential street｜住宅區街道 ; street lighting｜街道照明
tip_zh: street多指城鎮中兩旁有建築的道路。

meanings_zh: v. 包括；包含 | v. 使加入；把…列入
definition_en: have someone or something as part of a whole | make someone or something part of a group or activity
example1_en: Does the price include breakfast and a clean towel?
example1_zh: 這個價格包含早餐和一條幹淨毛巾嗎？
example2_en: Urban development plans should include affordable housing and reliable public transport to support low-income residents.
example2_zh: 城市發展規劃應包含經濟適用住房和可靠的公共交通，以支援低收入居民。
collocations: include someone in｜讓某人參與 ; include a range of｜包含一系列 ; price includes｜價格包含
tip_zh: include常列出部分內容，不表示完整清單。

meanings_zh: n. 收音機 | n. 無線電廣播；無線電通訊 | v. 用無線電聯絡或傳送
definition_en: a device used to receive and play broadcast sound | broadcasting or communication using electromagnetic waves | to contact someone or send information using radio equipment
example1_en: Dad keeps a small radio on the kitchen shelf.
example1_zh: 爸爸在廚房架子上放著一臺小收音機。
example2_en: Radio remains an important source of information in remote communities where reliable internet access is limited.
example2_zh: 在難以穩定上網的偏遠社群，廣播仍是重要的資訊來源。
collocations: listen to the radio｜聽廣播 ; radio station｜廣播電臺 ; radio programme｜廣播節目 ; radio signal｜無線電訊號
tip_zh: 聽廣播常說listen to the radio；在廣播中用on the radio。

meanings_zh: n. 郵局
definition_en: a place where people send mail and buy stamps
example1_en: I took the parcel to the post office before lunch.
example1_zh: 午飯前，我把包裹送到了郵局。
example2_en: A local post office can provide essential services for rural residents who lack reliable internet access.
example2_zh: 當地郵局可以為缺乏可靠網路連線的農村居民提供基本服務。
collocations: local post office｜當地郵局 ; post office counter｜郵局櫃檯 ; post office branch｜郵局支局
tip_zh: 標準拼寫為post office，兩詞之間不加連字元。

meanings_zh: n. 冰 | v. 給糕點覆糖霜
definition_en: water that has frozen solid | to cover a cake or biscuit with icing
example1_en: She dropped a few cubes of ice into her juice.
example1_zh: 她往果汁裡放了幾塊冰。
example2_en: The loss of polar ice threatens wildlife habitats and can accelerate warming by reducing the reflection of sunlight.
example2_zh: 極地冰層的消失威脅野生動物棲息地，還可能因減少陽光反射而加速變暖。
collocations: ice cube｜冰塊 ; sea ice｜海冰 ; melt the ice｜融化冰 ; ice a cake｜給蛋糕覆糖霜
tip_zh: ice指冰時通常不可數；一塊冰用an ice cube。

meanings_zh: n. 傍晚；晚上
definition_en: The part of the day between afternoon and bedtime.
example1_en: We spent the evening cooking and listening to music.
example1_zh: 我們做飯、聽音樂，度過了這個晚上。
example2_en: Evening classes allow working adults to gain new qualifications without giving up their current employment.
example2_zh: 晚間課程讓在職成年人無需辭去現有工作，也能獲得新的資格證書。
collocations: in the evening｜在晚上 ; this evening｜今晚 ; evening classes｜晚間課程 ; early evening｜傍晚時分
tip_zh: 泛指晚上用in the evening；this evening前不加介詞。

meanings_zh: pron. 一切；所有事物 | pron. 最重要的東西
definition_en: All things or all the things in a particular situation. | The most important thing in someone's life or situation.
example1_en: Everything in my bag got wet during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴風雨把我包裡的東西全弄溼了。
example2_en: Although digital resources are valuable, students should not assume that everything they read online is accurate.
example2_zh: 雖然數位資源很有價值，但學生不應認為自己在網上讀到的一切都準確無誤。
collocations: everything else｜其他所有事物 ; everything possible｜一切可能的事 ; mean everything to someone｜對某人無比重要
tip_zh: 作主語時謂語用單數：Everything is ready。

meanings_zh: n. 西；西方；西部 | adj. 西部的；朝西的 | adv. 向西；在西方
definition_en: the direction where the sun sets, opposite east | in or facing the direction where the sun sets | towards or in the west
example1_en: Our kitchen window faces west, catching the evening sunshine.
example1_zh: 我們廚房的窗戶朝西，能照到傍晚的陽光。
example2_en: Investment in the west of the country could reduce regional inequalities and create employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 對該國西部的投資可以縮小地區差距，並創造就業機會。
collocations: in the west｜在西部 ; head west｜向西行進 ; west coast｜西海岸 ; due west｜正西方
tip_zh: 方位一般小寫；the West指西方國家時大寫。

meanings_zh: n. 兄；弟
definition_en: A male who has one or both parents in common with you.
example1_en: My younger brother borrowed my bicycle this morning.
example1_zh: 我弟弟今天早上借用了我的腳踏車。
example2_en: Older brothers and sisters can support younger children's learning by reading with them regularly at home.
example2_zh: 哥哥姐姐可以通過經常在家陪弟弟妹妹閱讀來幫助他們學習。
collocations: older brother｜哥哥 ; younger brother｜弟弟 ; twin brother｜雙胞胎兄弟
tip_zh: brother不區分兄弟；用older或younger說明長幼。

meanings_zh: n. 山；高山 | n. 大量；一大堆
definition_en: a very high area of land with steep sides | a very large amount of something
example1_en: Snow covered the mountain even in the middle of summer.
example1_zh: 即使在盛夏，那座山仍被白雪覆蓋。
example2_en: Mountain communities often face higher transport costs because steep terrain makes road construction more difficult.
example2_zh: 山區社群往往面臨更高的運輸成本，因為陡峭的地形增加了修路的難度。
collocations: mountain range｜山脈 ; mountain peak｜山峰 ; climb a mountain｜登山 ; a mountain of work｜堆積如山的工作
tip_zh: 一座山用 mountain；山脈通常用 mountain range。

meanings_zh: prep. 比 | conj. 比
definition_en: used to introduce the second thing in a comparison | used before a clause expressing the other side of a comparison
example1_en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
example1_zh: 我的新背包比舊的輕。
example2_en: Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.
example2_zh: 在擁擠的城市，投資公共交通可能比增建道路更有效。
collocations: more than｜多於 ; less than｜少於 ; rather than｜而不是 ; other than｜除……以外
tip_zh: than用於比較；then表示“然後”，注意拼寫。

meanings_zh: adj. 溫暖的；暖和的 | adj. 熱情的；友好的 | v. 使暖和；變暖
definition_en: having a comfortable temperature that is not hot | showing kindness, friendliness, or affection | to become warmer or make something warmer
example1_en: This thick blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
example1_zh: 這條厚毯子讓我在涼颼颼的夜晚保持暖和。
example2_en: A warm welcome at school can help new students feel included and develop confidence.
example2_zh: 學校的熱情歡迎能幫助新生獲得歸屬感，並建立自信。
collocations: keep warm｜保暖 ; a warm welcome｜熱情歡迎 ; warm up｜熱身；使變暖 ; warm to someone｜漸漸喜歡上某人
tip_zh: warm比hot溫度低；warm to某人指漸漸喜歡對方。

meanings_zh: n. 未來；前途 | adj. 未來的；將來的
definition_en: The time ahead, or what will happen to someone or something. | Happening or existing at a time after the present.
example1_en: We talked about our future while walking home.
example1_zh: 我們走路回家時聊了聊我們的未來。
example2_en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to protect the environment for future generations worldwide.
example2_zh: 各國政府應投資可再生能源，為世界各地的子孫後代保護環境。
collocations: in the future｜在將來 ; near future｜不久的將來 ; future generations｜子孫後代 ; bright future｜光明的前途
tip_zh: in the future指將來；英式in future常指從今以後。

meanings_zh: adj. 德國的；德語的 | n. 德國人 | n. 德語
definition_en: relating to Germany, its people, or its language | a person from Germany | the language spoken in Germany and some neighbouring countries
example1_en: We shared a traditional German cake after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚飯後，我們分著吃了一塊傳統德國蛋糕。
example2_en: German universities attract international students through research opportunities and a wide range of degree programmes.
example2_zh: 德國大學通過研究機會和豐富的學位課程吸引國際學生。
collocations: German culture｜德國文化 ; learn German｜學德語 ; a German citizen｜德國公民
tip_zh: 首字母須大寫；指德語時通常不加冠詞。

meanings_zh: det. 所有的；整個的 | pron. 全部；所有人或事物 | adv. 完全地
definition_en: the whole amount of something or every member of a group | everything or everyone in a particular group | completely or entirely
example1_en: All the children brought fruit for the picnic.
example1_zh: 所有孩子都帶了水果來野餐。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of their income.
example2_zh: 政府應確保所有公民無論收入如何，都能獲得負擔得起的醫療服務。
collocations: all day｜一整天 ; all of us｜我們所有人 ; all the time｜一直 ; after all｜畢竟
tip_zh: all可接複數或不可數名詞；every接單數可數名詞。

meanings_zh: v. 來；來到 | v. 到來；發生 | v. 來自；源於
definition_en: Move towards the speaker or a particular place. | Arrive in time or happen. | Have a particular origin or source.
example1_en: Come inside and warm your hands by the fire.
example1_zh: 進來在火邊暖暖手吧。
example2_en: Much of the funding for public libraries comes from local government rather than private donations.
example2_zh: 公共圖書館的大部分資金來自地方政府，而非私人捐贈。
collocations: come home｜回家 ; come from｜來自 ; come true｜實現 ; come to an end｜結束
tip_zh: 不規則變化：come–came–come；come from表示來自。

meanings_zh: v. 吃；進食
definition_en: To put food in your mouth, chew it, and swallow
example1_en: We usually eat breakfast together before leaving the house.
example1_zh: 我們通常一起吃完早飯再出門。
example2_en: Schools can encourage children to eat more vegetables by providing affordable meals with a variety of fresh ingredients.
example2_zh: 學校可以提供價格實惠、包含多種新鮮食材的餐食，鼓勵孩子多吃蔬菜。
collocations: eat breakfast｜吃早飯 ; eat out｜外出就餐 ; eat a balanced diet｜均衡飲食 ; eat well｜吃得健康
tip_zh: 不規則變化：eat—ate—eaten。

meanings_zh: n. 胡蘿蔔 | n. 誘因；獎勵
definition_en: A long, usually orange root vegetable. | A reward offered to encourage someone to do something.
example1_en: She sliced a carrot and added it to the soup.
example1_zh: 她把一根胡蘿蔔切片，放進湯裡。
example2_en: Governments can use tax reductions as a carrot to encourage businesses to invest in renewable energy.
example2_zh: 政府可以用減稅作為激勵，鼓勵企業投資可再生能源。
collocations: raw carrot｜生胡蘿蔔 ; grated carrot｜胡蘿蔔絲 ; carrot and stick｜獎懲並用
tip_zh: 比喻獎勵或誘因；carrot and stick指獎懲並用。

meanings_zh: prep. 在附近；接近 | adv. 在附近；臨近 | adj. 近的；不久的
definition_en: close to a place, time, or state | at or towards a short distance away in space or time | not far away in distance or time
example1_en: We found a quiet café near the station.
example1_zh: 我們在車站附近找到了一家安靜的咖啡館。
example2_en: Building affordable housing near public transport can reduce commuting costs and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 在公共交通設施附近建設經濟適用住房，可以降低通勤成本並增加就業機會。
collocations: near the station｜在車站附近 ; in the near future｜在不久的將來 ; come near｜走近 ; nowhere near｜遠遠不及
tip_zh: near可直接接地點；nearly通常表示“幾乎”。

meanings_zh: n. 父親或母親 | n. 母公司 | v. 養育；教養
definition_en: a person's mother or father | a company that owns or controls another company | to raise and care for a child as a parent
example1_en: Each parent brought a snack for the school picnic.
example1_zh: 每位家長都為學校野餐帶了一份點心。
example2_en: Schools should involve parents in educational decisions because family support plays an important role in children's learning.
example2_zh: 學校應讓家長參與教育決策，因為家庭支援在孩子的學習中發揮著重要作用。
collocations: single parent｜單親家長 ; working parents｜在職父母 ; parent company｜母公司 ; parent involvement｜家長參與
tip_zh: parent指父母中的一位；parents通常指父母雙方。

meanings_zh: adj. 著名的；出名的
definition_en: Known by many people.
example1_en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
example1_zh: 這個村莊以美味的蘋果派聞名。
example2_en: Famous landmarks attract international visitors, but tourism revenue should also support the communities surrounding them.
example2_zh: 著名地標吸引著國際遊客，但旅遊收入也應惠及周邊社群。
collocations: famous for｜因……而出名 ; famous as｜作為……而出名 ; world famous｜世界聞名的
tip_zh: famous for接出名的原因，famous as接身份。

meanings_zh: adv. 僅僅；只是 | adv. 剛剛；正好 | adj. 公正的；正當的
definition_en: Only; no more than a particular amount or thing. | Very recently, or exactly at a particular point or degree. | Fair and morally right.
example1_en: I need just one more minute to finish packing.
example1_zh: 我只需要再一分鐘就能收拾好行李。
example2_en: A just society should ensure that all children can access quality education, regardless of family income.
example2_zh: 一個公正的社會應確保所有兒童都能獲得優質教育，不受家庭收入影響。
collocations: just a moment｜稍等片刻 ; just in time｜剛好趕上 ; just enough｜剛好足夠 ; a just society｜公正的社會
tip_zh: 作副詞可指僅僅、剛剛；作形容詞指公正的。

meanings_zh: n. 生日
definition_en: The yearly anniversary of the day someone was born.
example1_en: My sister baked a lemon cake for my birthday.
example1_zh: 姐姐為我的生日烤了一個檸檬蛋糕。
example2_en: Although birthday celebrations vary across cultures, they often provide opportunities for families to spend time together.
example2_zh: 雖然不同文化中的生日慶祝方式各異，但它們往往能讓家人有機會相聚。
collocations: a birthday cake｜生日蛋糕 ; a birthday present｜生日禮物 ; celebrate a birthday｜慶祝生日
tip_zh: 在某人生日當天用on，不用in或at。

meanings_zh: n. 黃油 | v. 塗黃油於
definition_en: a pale yellow fat made from cream, used in food | to spread butter on food
example1_en: She spread some butter on a slice of warm bread.
example1_zh: 她在一片溫熱的麵包上抹了些黃油。
example2_en: Replacing some butter with unsaturated oils can help people reduce their overall intake of saturated fat.
example2_zh: 用不飽和油脂替代部分黃油，有助於減少飽和脂肪的總體攝入量。
collocations: spread butter｜塗黃油 ; melted butter｜融化的黃油 ; a knob of butter｜一小塊黃油 ; butter toast｜給吐司塗黃油
tip_zh: butter是黃油，cream是奶油；作食品名通常不可數。

meanings_zh: n. 學院；高等專科學校 | n. 大學的學院
definition_en: An institution offering education beyond school, including practical or academic courses. | A constituent institution or division within a university.
example1_en: My cousin is studying nursing at a local college.
example1_zh: 我表姐正在當地一所學院學習護理。
example2_en: Making college education more affordable could improve social mobility and provide employers with a more skilled workforce.
example2_zh: 降低高等教育費用可以促進社會流動，併為僱主提供技能更強的勞動力。
collocations: go to college｜上大學或學院 ; college student｜大學生；學院學生 ; college education｜大學教育 ; community college｜社群學院
tip_zh: 美式常泛指大學；英式多指學院或繼續教育院校。

meanings_zh: v. 關上；關閉；結束 | adj. 近的；親密的 | adv. 靠近；接近
definition_en: Shut something or bring an activity to an end | Near in distance or connected by a strong personal relationship | At a short distance from someone or something
example1_en: Please close the window before the rain comes in.
example1_zh: 請在雨飄進來之前關上窗戶。
example2_en: When local libraries close, residents lose valuable spaces for independent learning and community activities.
example2_zh: 當本地圖書館關閉時，居民就失去了自主學習和開展社群活動的寶貴場所。
collocations: close a door｜關門 ; close to home｜離家近 ; a close friend｜親密的朋友 ; stay close｜待在近處
tip_zh: 動詞讀/z/；形容詞和副詞讀/s/。

meanings_zh: adv. 離開；脫離 | prep. 從……離開；離開……表面 | adj. 關閉的；不工作的
definition_en: away from a place or position | away from or no longer touching something | not operating or not working at a particular time
example1_en: The dog ran off when the gate opened.
example1_zh: 門一開，那隻狗就跑走了。
example2_en: Keeping unnecessary lights off in public buildings can reduce electricity consumption and lower operating costs.
example2_zh: 關閉公共建築內不必要的照明可以減少耗電量並降低運營成本。
collocations: turn off｜關掉 ; take off｜起飛；脫下 ; off duty｜不值班 ; day off｜休息日
tip_zh: off強調離開或關閉；of常表示所屬，勿混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 等待；等候 | v. 暫緩；推遲 | n. 等待；等候時間
definition_en: To let time pass until something happens or someone arrives. | To be left until a later time. | A period spent expecting something to happen.
example1_en: Please wait here while I find my keys.
example1_zh: 請在這裡等一下，我去找鑰匙。
example2_en: Patients in rural areas often wait longer for specialist treatment because local medical services are limited.
example2_zh: 由於當地醫療服務有限，農村地區的患者往往需要等待更久才能接受專科治療。
collocations: wait for someone｜等某人 ; wait patiently｜耐心等待 ; a long wait｜漫長的等待 ; wait and see｜等等看
tip_zh: 等人用wait for someone；等著做用wait to do。

meanings_zh: prep. 在…下面 | prep. 少於；低於 | prep. 在…狀態或控制下
definition_en: in or into a position below something | less than a particular amount, age, or level | experiencing a condition or being controlled by someone or something
example1_en: The cat curled up under the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 貓蜷縮在廚房的桌子下面。
example2_en: Under the new policy, local authorities must provide safer cycling routes near schools and residential areas.
example2_zh: 根據新政策，地方政府必須在學校和住宅區附近提供更安全的騎行路線。
collocations: under pressure｜承受壓力 ; under control｜受控 ; under construction｜在建 ; under the age of｜年齡不滿
tip_zh: under可表位置、數量或狀態：under pressure。

meanings_zh: adj. 義大利的；義大利語的 | n. 義大利語 | n. 義大利人
definition_en: Relating to Italy, its people, culture, or language | The main language spoken in Italy | A person from Italy
example1_en: We cooked Italian pasta with tomatoes and fresh basil.
example1_zh: 我們用番茄和新鮮羅勒做了義大利麵。
example2_en: Studying Italian architecture can help students understand how historical buildings influence contemporary urban design.
example2_zh: 研究義大利建築可以幫助學生理解歷史建築如何影響當代城市設計。
collocations: Italian cuisine｜義大利菜 ; speak Italian｜說義大利語 ; Italian architecture｜義大利建築
tip_zh: 國籍和語言名稱首字母大寫；義大利人複數為Italians。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上 | prep. 在某日；關於 | adv. 開著；執行中
definition_en: Touching and supported by a surface. | Used for days and dates, or to introduce a topic. | Operating or receiving power.
example1_en: Your keys are on the table beside the door.
example1_zh: 你的鑰匙在門旁的桌子上。
example2_en: Installing solar panels on public buildings can reduce energy costs and demonstrate a government's commitment to sustainability.
example2_zh: 在公共建築上安裝太陽能板可以降低能源成本，並展現政府對可持續發展的重視。
collocations: on the table｜在桌上 ; on Monday｜在星期一 ; a report on education｜一份關於教育的報告 ; switch on｜開啟
tip_zh: 具體某天用on；月份用in；鐘點用at。

meanings_zh: adj. 個人的；本人的 | adj. 私人的；隱私的 | adj. 針對個人的；人身攻擊的
definition_en: Belonging or relating to one particular person. | Concerning someone's private life rather than public matters. | Directed at someone's character rather than their ideas or actions.
example1_en: Please keep your personal belongings close while boarding the train.
example1_zh: 上火車時，請將個人物品放在身邊。
example2_en: Online services should protect personal information and explain clearly how they collect and use customer data.
example2_zh: 線上服務應保護個人資訊，並清楚說明如何收集和使用客戶資料。
collocations: personal belongings｜個人物品 ; personal information｜個人資訊 ; personal experience｜親身經歷 ; personal attack｜人身攻擊
tip_zh: personal指個人的；personnel指全體員工，注意拼寫。

meanings_zh: adj. 可能的；可實現的 | adj. 或許合適的；潛在的
definition_en: able to happen, exist, or be done | worth considering as a choice or explanation
example1_en: Is it possible to book a table for tonight?
example1_zh: 可以預訂今晚的餐桌嗎？
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy makes it possible for countries to reduce their dependence on imported fuels.
example2_zh: 對可再生能源的投資使各國有可能減少對進口燃料的依賴。
collocations: as soon as possible｜儘快 ; possible explanation｜可能的解釋 ; make it possible｜使之成為可能
tip_zh: 常用it is possible to do；不說人is possible to do。

meanings_zh: n. 分（貨幣單位） | n. 一分硬幣
definition_en: a monetary unit worth one hundredth of a dollar or euro | a coin worth one cent
example1_en: I found a cent under the sofa cushion.
example1_zh: 我在沙發坐墊下面找到了一枚一分硬幣。
example2_en: For households with limited incomes, every cent saved on essential goods can contribute to greater financial security.
example2_zh: 對收入有限的家庭而言，購買必需品時省下的每一分錢都能增強經濟保障。
collocations: every cent｜每一分錢 ; not a cent｜一分錢也沒有 ; a fifty-cent coin｜一枚五十分硬幣
tip_zh: cent是可數名詞；金額超過一分通常用cents。

meanings_zh: v. 描述；形容
definition_en: to explain what someone or something is like
example1_en: Can you describe the bag you left on the bus?
example1_zh: 你能描述一下你落在公交車上的包嗎？
example2_en: The report describes how access to public parks influences physical activity among residents of crowded cities.
example2_zh: 該報告描述了公共公園的可達性如何影響人口密集城市居民的體育活動。
collocations: describe something in detail｜詳細描述某事物 ; describe something as｜把某事物形容為 ; describe a process｜描述一個過程
tip_zh: 說describe something to someone，不說describe someone something。

meanings_zh: v. 說；表達 | v. 寫著；表明 | n. 發言權；決定權
definition_en: To express something using words. | To give information in writing or through other evidence. | The opportunity to influence a decision.
example1_en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
example1_zh: 請再說一遍你的名字，好讓我記住。
example2_en: Residents should have a say in planning decisions that directly affect their neighbourhoods and daily lives.
example2_zh: 居民應當對直接影響其社群和日常生活的規劃決策擁有發言權。
collocations: say hello｜打招呼 ; say something to someone｜對某人說某事 ; have a say in｜對……有發言權 ; say for certain｜肯定地說
tip_zh: 說某事用say something；告訴某人用tell someone。

meanings_zh: pron. 大量；許多 | adv. 很；經常 | n. 一塊地；場地
definition_en: a large amount or number, in a lot or lots | very much or often, in the phrase a lot | an area of land used for a particular purpose
example1_en: We bought a lot of fresh fruit today.
example1_zh: 我們今天買了很多新鮮水果。
example2_en: Cities can save a lot of energy by improving public transport and encouraging residents to walk.
example2_zh: 城市可以通過改善公共交通並鼓勵居民步行來節約大量能源。
collocations: a lot of time｜大量時間 ; lots of people｜許多人 ; a lot better｜好得多 ; a parking lot｜停車場
tip_zh: a lot of接可數複數或不可數名詞；a lot可修飾動詞。

meanings_zh: n. 祖父；外祖父
definition_en: The father of your mother or father.
example1_en: My grandfather taught me how to grow tomatoes.
example1_zh: 我的祖父教過我如何種番茄。
example2_en: A grandfather who provides regular childcare can strengthen family bonds and support working parents.
example2_zh: 經常幫忙照顧孩子的祖父或外祖父能夠增進家庭感情，併為在職父母提供支援。
collocations: maternal grandfather｜外祖父 ; paternal grandfather｜祖父
tip_zh: 不區分父系母系；外祖父可說maternal grandfather。

meanings_zh: adj. 親愛的；珍愛的 | adj. 昂貴的 | int. 哎呀；天哪
definition_en: loved or valued very much | costing a lot of money | used to express surprise, worry, or disappointment
example1_en: This little garden is very dear to my grandmother.
example1_zh: 祖母十分珍愛這座小花園。
example2_en: Places that are dear to local residents deserve consideration when urban redevelopment plans are prepared.
example2_zh: 制定城市改造計劃時，應顧及當地居民珍愛的場所。
collocations: a dear friend｜摯友 ; dear to someone｜為某人所珍愛 ; oh dear｜哎呀
tip_zh: dear表“貴”主要用於英式口語；稱呼常用Dear。

meanings_zh: adj. 抱歉的；後悔的 | adj. 難過的；同情的
definition_en: feeling regret about something you did or something that happened | feeling sadness or sympathy because of someone's difficulties
example1_en: I'm sorry I spilled juice on your clean shirt.
example1_zh: 很抱歉，我把果汁灑在了你的乾淨襯衫上。
example2_en: Although companies may say they are sorry for environmental damage, meaningful action is needed to restore public trust.
example2_zh: 儘管企業可能對環境破壞表示歉意，但恢復公眾信任需要切實行動。
collocations: sorry for being late｜為遲到感到抱歉 ; sorry about the mistake｜為錯誤感到抱歉 ; feel sorry for someone｜同情某人 ; sorry to hear that｜聽到那件事很難過
tip_zh: sorry for doing表示為所做之事道歉。

meanings_zh: n. 耳朵 | n. 辨音能力；聽覺 | n. 穀穗
definition_en: One of the organs on your head used for hearing. | The ability to recognise and distinguish sounds. | The grain-bearing part of a cereal plant, such as wheat.
example1_en: My ears felt cold, so I pulled on a hat.
example1_zh: 我的耳朵覺得冷，於是我戴上了帽子。
example2_en: Regular exposure to loud music can damage the ears and lead to permanent hearing loss.
example2_zh: 經常接觸高音量音樂可能損傷耳朵，並導致永久性聽力損失。
collocations: an ear for music｜音樂辨音能力 ; ear infection｜耳部感染 ; an ear of wheat｜一穗小麥 ; ear protection｜護耳用品
tip_zh: have an ear for表示善於辨聽音樂、語言等。

meanings_zh: adj. 健康的 | adj. 有益健康的 | adj. 良好的；興旺的
definition_en: physically well and not suffering from illness | helping to maintain or improve health | successful, strong, or developing in a positive way
example1_en: Our cat stays healthy with regular exercise and checkups.
example1_zh: 我們家的貓通過經常運動和定期檢查保持健康。
example2_en: Schools should provide healthy meals to support children's physical development and encourage better eating habits from an early age.
example2_zh: 學校應提供健康膳食，以促進兒童身體發育，並鼓勵他們從小養成更好的飲食習慣。
collocations: a healthy diet｜健康飲食 ; a healthy lifestyle｜健康的生活方式 ; stay healthy｜保持健康 ; a healthy economy｜繁榮的經濟
tip_zh: 既可形容身體健康，也可形容飲食等有益健康。

meanings_zh: v. 笑；發笑 | n. 笑；笑聲
definition_en: To make sounds showing amusement or happiness. | The sound or act of expressing amusement.
example1_en: The baby's funny dance made everyone laugh at dinner.
example1_zh: 寶寶滑稽的舞蹈讓吃晚飯的每個人都笑了。
example2_en: People who laugh together regularly may develop stronger social bonds and cope better with everyday stress.
example2_zh: 經常一起歡笑的人可能建立更牢固的社會聯絡，並更好地應對日常壓力。
collocations: laugh out loud｜大聲笑出來 ; make someone laugh｜逗某人笑 ; laugh at a joke｜聽了笑話發笑 ; a hearty laugh｜開懷大笑
tip_zh: laugh at人常指嘲笑；laugh with人指一起笑。

meanings_zh: v. 找到；發現 | v. 覺得；認為 | n. 發現物
definition_en: To discover something or locate what you were looking for. | To have a particular opinion or experience of something. | Something useful or valuable that someone discovers.
example1_en: I finally found my keys inside my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 我終於在外套口袋裡找到了鑰匙。
example2_en: Many students find online courses convenient, although some struggle to stay motivated without classroom interaction.
example2_zh: 許多學生覺得網路課程很方便，但有些人在缺少課堂互動時難以保持學習動力。
collocations: find a solution｜找到解決辦法 ; find out｜查明；弄清 ; find it difficult to｜覺得做某事困難 ; a valuable find｜有價值的發現物
tip_zh: 過去式和過去分詞均為found；find＋賓語＋形容詞。

meanings_zh: v. 賣；出售 | v. 有銷路；賣得 | v. 使人接受；推銷
definition_en: to give something to someone in exchange for money | to be bought in a particular quantity or way | to persuade someone to accept an idea or proposal
example1_en: They sell fresh bread at the market every Saturday.
example1_zh: 他們每週六都在市場賣新鮮麵包。
example2_en: Small businesses increasingly sell their products online to reach customers beyond their local communities.
example2_zh: 小企業越來越多地線上銷售產品，以吸引本地社群以外的顧客。
collocations: sell out｜售罄 ; sell well｜暢銷 ; sell something to someone｜把某物賣給某人 ; sell an idea｜推銷一個想法
tip_zh: 過去式和過去分詞均為sold；sell well常用主動形式。

meanings_zh: v. 走；步行 | n. 散步；步行路程
definition_en: To move on foot at a pace slower than running | A journey made on foot, often for pleasure
example1_en: We walk to the bakery every Sunday morning.
example1_zh: 我們每個星期天早上都步行去麵包店。
example2_en: Safe pavements and attractive public spaces encourage residents to walk rather than drive for short journeys.
example2_zh: 安全的人行道和宜人的公共空間能鼓勵居民短途出行時步行而不開車。
collocations: go for a walk｜去散步 ; walk to school｜步行上學 ; walk the dog｜遛狗 ; a brisk walk｜快步走
tip_zh: 字母l不發音；walk the dog意為遛狗。

meanings_zh: prep. 作為；以……身份 | conj. 當……時；因為；如同 | adv. 同樣地；一樣地
definition_en: used to indicate someone's role or something's purpose | introduces a time, reason, or way something happens | used in comparisons to show an equal degree
example1_en: She works as a guide at the local museum.
example1_zh: 她在當地博物館擔任講解員。
example2_en: As public transport becomes more reliable, fewer commuters may choose to drive to work.
example2_zh: 隨著公共交通變得更加可靠，選擇開車上班的通勤者可能會減少。
collocations: work as｜擔任 ; as a result｜因此 ; as soon as｜一……就…… ; as well as｜除……之外還
tip_zh: as表示實際身份；like表示相似。重讀時讀/æz/。

meanings_zh: v. 跑；奔跑 | v. 經營；管理 | v. 運轉；執行
definition_en: move quickly on foot, lifting both feet between steps | manage a business, organisation, or activity | operate, or make a machine or program operate
example1_en: We ran through the park before breakfast today.
example1_zh: 今天早飯前，我們跑步穿過了公園。
example2_en: Local councils often run training programmes to help unemployed residents develop skills needed by employers.
example2_zh: 地方議會經常開辦培訓專案，幫助失業居民培養僱主所需的技能。
collocations: run a business｜經營企業 ; run a programme｜開展專案 ; run smoothly｜執行順暢 ; run a marathon｜跑馬拉松
tip_zh: 過去式ran，過去分詞run；現在分詞running。

meanings_zh: n. 光；光線；燈 | adj. 輕的；明亮的；淺色的 | v. 點燃；照亮
definition_en: brightness that enables sight, or a device producing it | not heavy, bright, or pale in colour | make something burn or provide brightness
example1_en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
example1_zh: 溫暖的光線透過窗簾照進了我們的臥室。
example2_en: Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
example2_zh: 讓自然光進入教室可能有助於提高學生的專注力，並減少用電量。
collocations: natural light｜自然光 ; turn on the light｜開燈 ; light a candle｜點蠟燭 ; light luggage｜輕便行李
tip_zh: 光線通常不可數；一盞燈用a light；動詞過去式常用lit。

meanings_zh: v. 看；注視 | v. 看起來；顯得 | n. 看；神情；外觀
definition_en: direct your eyes towards someone or something | appear to have a particular quality or condition | an act of looking, or someone's expression or appearance
example1_en: Look at the tiny bird beside the window.
example1_zh: 看窗邊那隻小鳥。
example2_en: Public parks often look more attractive when local residents help maintain their gardens and pathways.
example2_zh: 噹噹地居民協助維護花園和步道時，公共公園往往顯得更有吸引力。
collocations: look at｜看 ; look forward to｜期待 ; take a look｜看一看 ; look like｜看起來像
tip_zh: look at後接看的物件；look作系動詞後接形容詞。

meanings_zh: num. 第一 | adv. 首先；最初；優先
definition_en: coming before all others in order or time | before anything or anyone else
example1_en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
example1_zh: 這是我第一次到海邊來。
example2_en: Governments should first improve public transport before encouraging residents to give up private cars.
example2_zh: 政府應先改善公共交通，再鼓勵居民放棄私家車。
collocations: first place｜第一名 ; at first｜起初 ; first of all｜首先 ; first aid｜急救
tip_zh: at first指起初；first可用於列舉第一點。

meanings_zh: adj. 昂貴的；花錢多的
definition_en: costing a large amount of money
example1_en: These boots are too expensive for my budget.
example1_zh: 這雙靴子太貴，超出了我的預算。
example2_en: Housing in major cities is becoming increasingly expensive, forcing many young workers to live farther from their workplaces.
example2_zh: 大城市的住房越來越貴，迫使許多年輕職工住到離工作地點更遠的地方。
collocations: too expensive｜太貴 ; increasingly expensive｜日益昂貴 ; expensive to maintain｜維護費用高 ; an expensive mistake｜代價高昂的錯誤
tip_zh: 物品貴用expensive，價格高用high。

meanings_zh: n. 語言 | n. 措辭；表達方式
definition_en: a system of words or gestures used for communication | the words and style used in a particular context
example1_en: My neighbour teaches me a little of her language.
example1_zh: 鄰居教我一點她的語言。
example2_en: Learning a foreign language can broaden students' cultural understanding and improve their future employment prospects.
example2_zh: 學習外語可以拓寬學生的文化視野，並改善他們未來的就業前景。
collocations: foreign language｜外語 ; body language｜肢體語言 ; language barrier｜語言障礙 ; formal language｜正式用語
tip_zh: 指某種語言時可數；泛指語言能力時常不可數。

meanings_zh: adj. 忙碌的 | adj. 繁忙的；人來車往的 | adj. 佔線的
definition_en: Having many things to do or being actively occupied. | Full of people, traffic, or activity. | Already being used, especially a telephone line.
example1_en: I am busy making soup for dinner right now.
example1_zh: 我現在正忙著做晚餐要喝的湯。
example2_en: Busy urban roads can discourage cycling unless local authorities provide safe routes separated from motor traffic.
example2_zh: 繁忙的城市道路可能讓人不願騎車，除非地方政府提供與機動車流隔離的安全路線。
collocations: busy doing something｜忙著做某事 ; busy with work｜忙於工作 ; a busy street｜繁忙的街道 ; a busy schedule｜緊湊的日程
tip_zh: 用busy doing或busy with，不用busy to do。

meanings_zh: v. 寫；書寫 | v. 創作；寫作 | v. 寫信
definition_en: To form words on paper or a screen. | To create a story, article, or piece of music. | To send someone a letter or written message.
example1_en: Please write your address on this small card.
example1_zh: 請把你的地址寫在這張小卡片上。
example2_en: Students who write regularly often develop stronger reasoning skills and express complex ideas more clearly.
example2_zh: 經常寫作的學生往往能培養更強的推理能力，並更清晰地表達複雜觀點。
collocations: write an essay｜寫文章 ; write to someone｜給某人寫信 ; write down｜寫下；記下
tip_zh: 不規則變化：write—wrote—written。

meanings_zh: n. 西班牙語 | adj. 西班牙的；西班牙語的
definition_en: the language spoken in Spain and many Latin American countries | relating to Spain, its people, culture, or language
example1_en: I practise Spanish with my neighbour after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚飯後我和鄰居一起練習西班牙語。
example2_en: Learning Spanish can broaden students' access to literature and improve their opportunities for international employment.
example2_zh: 學習西班牙語能拓寬學生接觸文學作品的渠道，並增加他們在國際就業市場上的機會。
collocations: speak Spanish｜說西班牙語 ; Spanish culture｜西班牙文化 ; Spanish-speaking countries｜西班牙語國家
tip_zh: 首字母大寫；一個西班牙人可說a Spanish person。

meanings_zh: n. 狗；犬 | v. 長期困擾；糾纏
definition_en: An animal often kept as a pet or trained for work. | To cause persistent problems for someone or something.
example1_en: Our dog waits by the door every afternoon.
example1_zh: 我們的狗每天下午都守在門邊。
example2_en: Training a guide dog requires considerable time, but it can greatly improve someone's independence.
example2_zh: 訓練一隻導盲犬需要大量時間，但它能顯著增強使用者的獨立生活能力。
collocations: walk the dog｜遛狗 ; a guide dog｜導盲犬 ; a stray dog｜流浪狗 ; be dogged by problems｜長期受問題困擾
tip_zh: 動詞常見被動式be dogged by，表示長期受困擾。

meanings_zh: n. 葡萄酒
definition_en: An alcoholic drink usually made from fermented grapes
example1_en: The restaurant uses a little wine in this mushroom sauce.
example1_zh: 這家餐館在這款蘑菇醬里加了少量葡萄酒。
example2_en: Climate change is affecting wine production as rising temperatures alter grape quality and harvest times.
example2_zh: 氣候變化正在影響葡萄酒生產，因為氣溫上升改變了葡萄品質和採收時間。
collocations: red wine｜紅葡萄酒 ; white wine｜白葡萄酒 ; wine production｜葡萄酒生產 ; a bottle of wine｜一瓶葡萄酒
tip_zh: 泛指葡萄酒時不可數；多種葡萄酒可用wines。

meanings_zh: v. 說話；交談；談論 | n. 談話；會談 | n. 演講；講座
definition_en: to speak to someone or discuss something | a conversation or discussion between people | a speech given to an audience about a subject
example1_en: We talked about our weekend plans over breakfast.
example1_zh: 我們吃早飯時聊了聊週末的計劃。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to talk openly about stress and seek support when they need it.
example2_zh: 學校應鼓勵學生坦誠談論壓力，並在需要時尋求幫助。
collocations: talk about something｜談論某事 ; talk to someone｜與某人交談 ; give a talk｜作演講 ; hold talks｜舉行會談
tip_zh: talk about接話題；talk to或with接人。

meanings_zh: n. 辦公室；辦公樓 | n. 辦事處；服務處 | n. 公職；官職
definition_en: a room or building where people do administrative work | a place providing a particular service or handling official business | an official position of responsibility, especially in government
example1_en: I left my umbrella under the desk at the office.
example1_zh: 我把傘落在辦公室的桌子下面了。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to divide their time between the office and home.
example2_zh: 靈活的工作安排讓員工能夠把工作時間分配在辦公室和家中。
collocations: office hours｜辦公時間 ; head office｜總部 ; hold office｜擔任公職 ; take office｜就職
tip_zh: 在辦公室用in the office；任公職用in office。

meanings_zh: n. 褲子（美式） | n. 內褲（英式）
definition_en: Clothing covering the legs separately, from the waist down. | Underwear worn around the hips and bottom.
example1_en: These pants have deep pockets for my keys.
example1_zh: 這條褲子的口袋很深，可以裝我的鑰匙。
example2_en: Some schools allow students to wear comfortable pants rather than requiring a traditional formal uniform.
example2_zh: 有些學校允許學生穿舒適的褲子，而不要求穿傳統的正式校服。
collocations: a pair of pants｜一條褲子；一條內褲 ; loose pants｜寬鬆的褲子 ; underpants｜內褲
tip_zh: 美式指褲子，英式常指內褲；用 a pair of 計數。

meanings_zh: n. 朋友；友人
definition_en: someone you know well, like, and enjoy spending time with
example1_en: I met an old friend at the market yesterday.
example1_zh: 我昨天在市場遇到了一位老朋友。
example2_en: Maintaining close friendships can improve mental wellbeing, as friends often provide emotional support during difficult periods.
example2_zh: 維持親密友誼可以改善心理健康，因為朋友常在困難時期提供情感支援。
collocations: close friend｜親密的朋友 ; childhood friend｜兒時的朋友 ; make friends with｜與……交朋友 ; keep in touch with friends｜與朋友保持聯絡
tip_zh: “與某人交朋友”用make friends with，friends用複數。

meanings_zh: adj. 確信的；有把握的 | adj. 一定會的；必然的 | adv. 當然；確實
definition_en: Feeling no doubt that something is true or correct. | Certain to happen or do something. | Used informally to agree or strongly confirm something.
example1_en: Are you sure you left your keys here?
example1_zh: 你確定把鑰匙落在這裡了嗎？
example2_en: Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
example2_zh: 政府必須確保農村社群能夠穩定地獲得基本醫療服務。
collocations: make sure｜確保；確認 ; be sure of｜確信 ; be sure to｜一定會；務必 ; for sure｜確切地；肯定
tip_zh: be sure of表確信；be sure to可表必然或叮囑。

meanings_zh: adv. 很；非常 | adj. 正是的；恰好的
definition_en: Used to make an adjective or adverb stronger. | Used to emphasize an exact person, thing, place, or time.
example1_en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool.
example1_zh: 湯很燙，先讓它涼一涼。
example2_en: Reliable public transport is very important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
example2_zh: 對於買不起汽車的居民來說，可靠的公共交通非常重要。
collocations: very important｜非常重要 ; very carefully｜非常仔細地 ; the very beginning｜最開始 ; the very same｜完全相同的
tip_zh: very通常修飾形容詞或副詞；修飾動詞常用very much。

meanings_zh: n. 跳舞；舞蹈
definition_en: the activity of moving your body rhythmically, usually to music
example1_en: We go dancing together at the community centre every Saturday.
example1_zh: 我們每週六都一起去社群中心跳舞。
example2_en: Regular dancing can improve physical fitness while providing opportunities for social interaction across different age groups.
example2_zh: 經常跳舞可以改善體能，同時為不同年齡群體提供社交機會。
collocations: go dancing｜去跳舞 ; ballroom dancing｜交誼舞 ; folk dancing｜民間舞蹈
tip_zh: 作活動名詞通常不可數；去跳舞用go dancing。

meanings_zh: det. 更多的；額外的 | adv. 更；更加 | pron. 更多；額外的數量
definition_en: A greater or additional amount or number of something. | To a greater degree or extent. | A greater or additional amount or number.
example1_en: Could you add more rice to my bowl, please?
example1_zh: 請再給我的碗裡添點米飯，好嗎？
example2_en: Governments should invest more resources in preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
example2_zh: 政府應加大對預防保健的資源投入，以長期減輕醫院的壓力。
collocations: more than｜多於 ; more and more｜越來越多 ; more likely｜更有可能 ; more information｜更多資訊
tip_zh: 可修飾可數或不可數名詞；是 many、much 的比較級。

meanings_zh: n. 書；書籍 | v. 預訂；預約
definition_en: A set of pages joined together for reading | To arrange in advance to use a service or attend something
example1_en: I left my book on the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我把書落在廚房的桌子上了。
example2_en: Public libraries provide free access to books, helping people continue learning regardless of their income.
example2_zh: 公共圖書館提供免費借閱書籍的機會，讓不同收入的人都能持續學習。
collocations: read a book｜讀書 ; borrow a book｜借書 ; book a flight｜預訂航班 ; book an appointment｜預約
tip_zh: book 作動詞表示預訂，可直接接房間、機票等。

meanings_zh: n. 家；住所；家鄉 | adv. 在家；回家 | adj. 家庭的；國內的
definition_en: The place where someone lives or feels they belong. | At or towards the place where you live. | Relating to your house or your own country.
example1_en: We walked home together after dinner at the café.
example1_zh: 在咖啡館吃過晚飯後，我們一起走回家。
example2_en: Working from home can reduce commuting costs, but it may also limit social interaction among colleagues.
example2_zh: 居家辦公可以降低通勤成本，但也可能限制同事之間的社互動動。
collocations: feel at home｜感到自在 ; return home｜回家 ; home country｜祖國 ; leave home｜離家
tip_zh: home作副詞時前面不加to：go home。

meanings_zh: n. 日期 | n. 約會 | v. 確定年代；始於
definition_en: A particular day of a month or year. | An arranged meeting, especially with someone you find romantically attractive. | To establish something's age, or originate in a particular period.
example1_en: Have you chosen a date for the picnic?
example1_zh: 你選好野餐的日期了嗎？
example2_en: Researchers used wooden tools found nearby to date the remains of this ancient village.
example2_zh: 研究人員利用附近發現的木製工具確定這座古村落遺蹟的年代。
collocations: set a date｜定日期 ; go on a date｜去約會 ; date back to｜追溯到 ; expiry date｜到期日
tip_zh: date back to表示始於某時期，不用被動語態。

meanings_zh: n. 俱樂部；社團 | n. 夜總會 | n. 高爾夫球杆；棍棒
definition_en: an organisation whose members share an interest or activity | a place where people dance and socialise at night | a stick used to hit a golf ball or strike something
example1_en: I joined a chess club to meet new people.
example1_zh: 我加入了一個國際象棋俱樂部，想認識些新朋友。
example2_en: A school sports club can help students develop teamwork skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
example2_zh: 學校體育社團可以幫助學生培養團隊合作能力，同時鼓勵他們經常鍛鍊。
collocations: join a club｜加入俱樂部 ; a sports club｜體育俱樂部 ; a club member｜俱樂部成員 ; a golf club｜高爾夫球杆
tip_zh: join a club表示加入社團，不用join in a club。

meanings_zh: num. 一百
definition_en: the number equal to ten times ten
example1_en: The hall can hold about a hundred people.
example1_zh: 這個大廳大約能容納一百人。
example2_en: Several hundred residents participated in the survey about proposed improvements to local parks and cycle routes.
example2_zh: 數百名居民參與了關於當地公園和腳踏車路線改進提案的調查。
collocations: a hundred people｜一百人 ; two hundred｜兩百 ; hundreds of｜數以百計的
tip_zh: 具體數詞後用hundred；泛指數百用hundreds of。

meanings_zh: n. 馬桶；便器 | n. 廁所；洗手間
definition_en: a bowl-shaped fixture used for getting rid of bodily waste | a room containing a toilet
example1_en: The toilet upstairs keeps making a strange dripping sound.
example1_zh: 樓上的馬桶一直髮出奇怪的滴水聲。
example2_en: Access to clean public toilets is essential for protecting health and making urban spaces welcoming to everyone.
example2_zh: 提供乾淨的公共廁所，對保障健康和打造人人友好的城市空間至關重要。
collocations: flush the toilet｜沖廁所 ; public toilets｜公共廁所 ; toilet paper｜衛生紙 ; toilet seat｜馬桶座圈
tip_zh: 美式toilet通常指馬桶；問公共洗手間常用restroom。

meanings_zh: n. 祖母；外祖母
definition_en: The mother of your father or mother.
example1_en: My grandmother grows fresh herbs on her kitchen windowsill.
example1_zh: 我的祖母在廚房窗臺上種新鮮的香草。
example2_en: For many working parents, a grandmother provides essential childcare and helps maintain strong family connections.
example2_zh: 對許多在職父母來說，祖母或外祖母提供了不可或缺的育兒幫助，也有助於維繫緊密的家庭關係。
collocations: maternal grandmother｜外祖母 ; paternal grandmother｜祖母 ; great-grandmother｜曾祖母；曾外祖母
tip_zh: 可指祖母或外祖母；口語常用grandma。

meanings_zh: n. 日本
definition_en: An island country in East Asia
example1_en: We travelled around Japan by train during our holiday.
example1_zh: 假期裡，我們乘火車遊覽了日本。
example2_en: Japan has invested in earthquake-resistant buildings to reduce the risks associated with living in a seismically active region.
example2_zh: 日本投資建設抗震建築，以降低生活在地震活躍地區所帶來的風險。
collocations: visit Japan｜遊覽日本 ; in Japan｜在日本 ; travel to Japan｜前往日本
tip_zh: 國名首字母大寫，通常不加the；日本人用Japanese。

meanings_zh: n. 獅子
definition_en: A large wild cat, whose males usually have thick neck hair.
example1_en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
example1_zh: 那頭獅子在樹蔭下休息。
example2_en: Protecting lions requires large habitats where they can hunt naturally without coming into conflict with farmers.
example2_zh: 保護獅子需要大片棲息地，讓它們能夠自然捕獵而不與農民發生衝突。
collocations: a pride of lions｜一群獅子 ; a lion's mane｜獅子的鬃毛 ; the lion's share｜最大的一份
tip_zh: 獅群用a pride of lions；母獅稱lioness。

meanings_zh: n. 運動；練習 | v. 鍛鍊；運動 | v. 行使；運用
definition_en: Physical activity for health, or a task for practising skills. | To do physical activity to stay healthy or become stronger. | To use a right, power, ability, or quality.
example1_en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
example1_zh: 我步行去商店，順便鍛鍊一下。
example2_en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
example2_zh: 經常運動能夠改善心理健康，並降低幾種常見慢性病的患病風險。
collocations: regular exercise｜經常運動 ; do exercises｜做練習 ; exercise caution｜謹慎行事 ; exercise your rights｜行使權利
tip_zh: 泛指運動時不可數；一項練習或一套動作中的動作可數。

meanings_zh: n. 牆；圍牆 | v. 用牆圍住；用牆隔開
definition_en: An upright structure enclosing, dividing, or supporting a space. | To surround or separate an area with a wall.
example1_en: We hung a colourful painting on the kitchen wall.
example1_zh: 我們在廚房牆上掛了一幅色彩鮮豔的畫。
example2_en: Green walls covered with plants can improve air quality and reduce heat in crowded urban areas.
example2_zh: 覆蓋植物的綠牆可以改善空氣質量，並減少擁擠城區的熱量。
collocations: stone wall｜石牆 ; boundary wall｜界牆 ; wall off｜用牆隔開
tip_zh: 圖片掛在牆上用on；嵌在牆內用in。

meanings_zh: det. 一些；若干 | pron. 一些人；一些事物 | adv. 大約
definition_en: An unspecified amount or number of something. | An unspecified number or amount of people or things. | Approximately, used before an amount or number.
example1_en: I bought some fresh bread on my way home.
example1_zh: 我在回家的路上買了些新鮮麵包。
example2_en: Some residents support the proposed cycle lanes, while others worry about losing parking spaces.
example2_zh: 一些居民支援擬建的腳踏車道，另一些人則擔心停車位會減少。
collocations: some of｜……中的一些 ; some time｜一段時間 ; some advice｜一些建議 ; some twenty years｜大約二十年
tip_zh: 可修飾複數名詞或不可數名詞；弱讀常為/səm/。

meanings_zh: adj. 感興趣的 | adj. 有利害關係的
definition_en: Wanting to learn about or take part in something. | Likely to be affected by a situation or decision.
example1_en: My sister is interested in learning to grow vegetables.
example1_zh: 我姐姐對學習種菜很感興趣。
example2_en: Students who are interested in science should have regular opportunities to conduct practical experiments.
example2_zh: 對科學感興趣的學生應該經常有機會開展實際實驗。
collocations: interested in｜對……感興趣 ; interested to hear｜有興趣聽到 ; interested parties｜利益相關方
tip_zh: 人感到有興趣用interested；後接in加名詞或動名詞。

meanings_zh: det. 哪一個；哪些 | pron. 哪一個；哪些 | pron. ……的那個；這件事
definition_en: Used before a noun to ask about a limited choice. | Used to ask about a choice without repeating the noun. | Introduces information about a thing or a previous statement.
example1_en: Which jacket should I wear to dinner tonight?
example1_zh: 今晚去吃飯我該穿哪件夾克？
example2_en: Governments must decide which policies will improve air quality without placing excessive financial pressure on households.
example2_zh: 政府必須決定哪些政策能改善空氣質量，又不會給家庭造成過大的經濟壓力。
collocations: which of｜……中的哪一個 ; which one｜哪一個 ; in which case｜如果是那樣的話
tip_zh: which常用於限定範圍內的選擇；what範圍更開放。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；方式 | n. 路線；方向 | adv. 遠遠地；大大地
definition_en: A method of doing something. | A route or direction leading somewhere. | By a large amount or distance.
example1_en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
example1_zh: 教我一個更簡單的疊床單方法吧。
example2_en: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通是減少交通擁堵和城市空氣汙染的有效方法。
collocations: an effective way｜一種有效的方法 ; find a way｜找到辦法 ; on the way｜在途中 ; way too expensive｜貴得多
tip_zh: “做某事的方法”可用way to do或way of doing。

meanings_zh: n. 手臂 | n. 扶手；臂狀部件 | v. 武裝；提供裝備
definition_en: The body part connecting your shoulder to your hand. | A projecting part of an object, especially a chair. | To provide weapons or useful tools for a task.
example1_en: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
example1_zh: 她輕輕地把熟睡的寶寶抱在懷裡。
example2_en: Schools should arm students with practical skills that help them adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.
example2_zh: 學校應讓學生掌握實用技能，幫助他們適應快速變化的職場。
collocations: fold your arms｜雙臂交叉 ; a chair arm｜椅子扶手 ; arm someone with knowledge｜用知識充實某人
tip_zh: 表“武器”用複數arms；arm還可作動詞。

meanings_zh: n. 成年女性；女子
definition_en: An adult female person.
example1_en: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers on her balcony.
example1_zh: 隔壁那位女士在陽臺上種了漂亮的花。
example2_en: Ensuring that every woman has access to education can improve health and economic opportunities across generations.
example2_zh: 確保每位女性都能接受教育，可以改善幾代人的健康狀況和經濟機會。
collocations: young woman｜年輕女性 ; working woman｜職業女性 ; women's rights｜女性權利
tip_zh: 複數women讀/ˈwɪmɪn/，注意首音節變化。

meanings_zh: adj. 下一個的；緊接著的 | adv. 接下來；下次
definition_en: coming immediately after the present one | immediately after this; on the following occasion
example1_en: Our next bus leaves in about ten minutes.
example1_zh: 我們要坐的下一班公交車大約十分鐘後發車。
example2_en: Over the next decade, governments will need to invest more heavily in affordable public transport.
example2_zh: 未來十年，各國政府需要加大對價格可負擔的公共交通的投入。
collocations: next week｜下週 ; the next step｜下一步 ; next time｜下次 ; next to｜緊挨著
tip_zh: “下週”用next week，不加the；the next week指隨後一週。

meanings_zh: n. 書店
definition_en: a store that sells books
example1_en: The bookstore near my flat stays open until nine.
example1_zh: 我公寓附近的書店一直營業到九點。
example2_en: Although online shopping offers convenience, a physical bookstore allows customers to browse and receive personal recommendations.
example2_zh: 雖然網購很方便，但實體書店能讓顧客翻閱書籍並獲得個性化推薦。
collocations: online bookstore｜網上書店 ; campus bookstore｜校園書店 ; used bookstore｜二手書店
tip_zh: bookstore是美式常用詞，不是借書的library。

meanings_zh: n. 警察；警方 | v. 維持治安；監督執行
definition_en: The official organisation responsible for preventing crime and maintaining order. | To maintain order somewhere or ensure rules are obeyed.
example1_en: The police helped us find our missing bicycle.
example1_zh: 警方幫我們找到了丟失的腳踏車。
example2_en: Effective cooperation between police and local residents can improve public safety and build trust within communities.
example2_zh: 警方與當地居民的有效合作可以改善公共安全，並建立社群內部的信任。
collocations: police officer｜警察 ; police station｜警察局 ; call the police｜報警 ; police an event｜維持活動秩序
tip_zh: the police作主語用複數；一名警察用a police officer。

meanings_zh: adj. 年輕的；幼小的 | n. 幼崽；幼鳥
definition_en: Having lived or existed for only a short time | The babies of an animal
example1_en: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
example1_zh: 一隻小貓在我空著的鞋子裡睡著了。
example2_en: Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.
example2_zh: 年輕人需要負擔得起的住房和穩定的工作，才能在大城市獨立生活。
collocations: young people｜年輕人 ; young children｜幼兒 ; from a young age｜從小 ; raise their young｜養育幼崽
tip_zh: the young指年輕人群體；動物的幼崽也可用young。

meanings_zh: n. 照片
definition_en: A picture made using a camera.
example1_en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
example1_zh: 我們在那座老橋旁拍了張照片。
example2_en: Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
example2_zh: 歷史照片為研究城市景觀和日常生活方式如何隨時間變化提供了寶貴證據。
collocations: take a photo｜拍照 ; a family photo｜全家福 ; a photo album｜相簿 ; a photo of｜一張……的照片
tip_zh: photo是photograph的常用簡稱；複數為photos。

meanings_zh: pron. 每個人；所有人
definition_en: Every person in a group, or all people generally.
example1_en: Everybody is waiting outside for the doors to open.
example1_zh: 所有人都在外面等著開門。
example2_en: Public libraries should offer accessible services so that everybody can benefit from opportunities for lifelong learning.
example2_zh: 公共圖書館應提供無障礙服務，讓每個人都能受益於終身學習的機會。
collocations: everybody else｜其他所有人 ; almost everybody｜幾乎所有人 ; everybody involved｜所有相關人員
tip_zh: 作主語時謂語用單數：Everybody is ready。

meanings_zh: n. 橙；橙子 | adj. 橙色的 | n. 橙色
definition_en: A round citrus fruit with orange skin and juicy flesh. | Having a colour between red and yellow. | The colour between red and yellow.
example1_en: I peeled an orange and shared it with my sister.
example1_zh: 我剝了一個橙子，和妹妹分著吃。
example2_en: An orange provides vitamin C, but a balanced diet requires a variety of foods.
example2_zh: 橙子能提供維生素C，但均衡飲食需要多種食物。
collocations: orange juice｜橙汁 ; orange peel｜橙皮 ; bright orange｜鮮橙色
tip_zh: 橙子可數；表示橙色時通常不可數。

meanings_zh: n. 電影院 | n. 電影藝術；電影業
definition_en: A place where people pay to watch films. | Films considered as an art form or industry.
example1_en: We met outside the cinema and bought some popcorn.
example1_zh: 我們在電影院外碰面，買了些爆米花。
example2_en: International cinema allows audiences to explore unfamiliar cultures and consider social issues from different perspectives.
example2_zh: 國際電影讓觀眾能夠了解陌生的文化，並從不同角度思考社會問題。
collocations: go to the cinema｜去看電影 ; a cinema ticket｜電影票 ; world cinema｜世界電影 ; independent cinema｜獨立電影
tip_zh: 英式常說go to the cinema，美式常說go to the movies。

meanings_zh: n. 比賽 | v. 相配；匹配；比得上 | n. 火柴
definition_en: a sports contest between two people or teams | to go well together, correspond, or equal something | a small stick that produces fire when rubbed
example1_en: We watched a football match at the local park.
example1_zh: 我們在附近的公園看了一場足球比賽。
example2_en: Training programmes should match the skills taught in colleges with the needs of local employers.
example2_zh: 培訓專案應使院校教授的技能與當地僱主的需求相匹配。
collocations: win a match｜贏得比賽 ; match A with B｜將A與B匹配 ; strike a match｜劃火柴 ; a perfect match｜絕配
tip_zh: match強調搭配協調；fit常指尺寸合適。

meanings_zh: n. 餐廳；飯廳
definition_en: A room where people eat meals.
example1_en: We put fresh flowers on the dining-room table.
example1_zh: 我們在飯廳的餐桌上擺了鮮花。
example2_en: A shared dining-room can encourage social interaction among older residents who might otherwise eat alone.
example2_zh: 公共餐廳可以促進老年住戶之間的社互動動，否則他們可能會獨自用餐。
collocations: dining-room table｜餐桌 ; dining-room furniture｜餐廳傢俱 ; a spacious dining-room｜寬敞的飯廳
tip_zh: 現代通常寫作dining room，指用餐房間。

meanings_zh: v. 需要；必須 | n. 需要；需求 | n. 貧困；困境
definition_en: To require something because it is necessary or important | Something necessary or the condition of requiring it | A situation in which essential things are lacking
example1_en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
example1_zh: 天氣炎熱時，這些植物需要更多的水。
example2_en: Cities need to improve public transport if they want to reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 城市若想減少人們對私家車的依賴，就需要改善公共交通。
collocations: need to do something｜需要做某事 ; meet basic needs｜滿足基本需求 ; in need｜處於困境中 ; an urgent need｜迫切的需要
tip_zh: need to do表需要做；need doing表需要被做。

meanings_zh: adj. 飢餓的 | adj. 渴望的
definition_en: Feeling the need or desire to eat. | Having a strong desire for something.
example1_en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
example1_zh: 在河邊走了很久之後，我覺得餓了。
example2_en: School meal programmes help hungry children concentrate in class and participate more actively in learning.
example2_zh: 學校供餐計劃幫助飢餓的孩子集中課堂注意力，更積極地參與學習。
collocations: feel hungry｜感到餓 ; go hungry｜捱餓 ; hungry for success｜渴望成功
tip_zh: hungry for後接名詞，表示渴望某物。

meanings_zh: adv. 以前
definition_en: Before the present time, following an expression of time
example1_en: I left my umbrella on the bus an hour ago.
example1_zh: 一小時前，我把雨傘落在了公交車上。
example2_en: Many jobs that seemed secure a decade ago now require workers to develop new digital skills.
example2_zh: 許多十年前看似穩定的工作，如今要求員工掌握新的數位技能。
collocations: a few days ago｜幾天前 ; a long time ago｜很久以前 ; not long ago｜不久前 ; as recently as a year ago｜就在一年前
tip_zh: ago放在時間段後，通常搭配一般過去時。

meanings_zh: n. 水果；果實 | n. 成果；結果 | v. 結果實
definition_en: Plant products containing seeds, often sweet and eaten as food. | The useful results of work or effort. | To produce fruit.
example1_en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
example1_zh: 她在我的午餐盒裡放了新鮮水果。
example2_en: Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.
example2_zh: 讓新鮮水果價格更親民，可以鼓勵低收入家庭養成更健康的飲食習慣。
collocations: fresh fruit｜新鮮水果 ; fruit juice｜果汁 ; bear fruit｜結果實；取得成果 ; the fruits of your labour｜勞動成果
tip_zh: 泛指水果通常不可數；fruits可指種類或成果。

meanings_zh: n. 兒子
definition_en: A male child in relation to his parents.
